summary.note: 2026-11-12: six standing forecasts lapsed INCORRECT on window closure with no resolving event -- fc-2026-10-22-cmmc-new-target (no new CMMC Reform Task Force target date; fourteenth-plus consecutive non-public cycle), fc-2026-10-12-reconciliation-floor-action (no Senate/House floor action on Golden Dome reconciliation funding), fc-2026-10-21-nato-blacksea-asset-named (no named NATO Black Sea asset), fc-2026-10-28-hormuz-portwatch-reconciliation (no fresher IMF PortWatch Hormuz transit figure), fc-2026-10-22-plex2shell-wider-confirm (no independent Plex2Shell exploitation confirmation beyond the original honeypot), and fc-2026-10-22-nato-blacksea-casualty-reconciliation (Black Sea casualty figures still unreconciled). fc-2026-11-10-fortimail-psirt-advisory graded CORRECT after multiple outlets confirmed Fortinet's own FG-IR-26-175 advisory explicitly denies a FortiMail 7.2-specific fix. Lead findings this cycle: (1) Trump's rhetoric on Iran swung sharply back hawkish -- 'total victory' vowed at a Veterans Day address on 11 Nov, one day after 'fairly soon'/'won't be necessary,' with CENTCOM's operational posture unchanged throughout. (2) Yesterday's conflicting rare-earth-suspension reports are resolved: MOFCOM/GACC Announcement No. 70 of 2025 lapsed on schedule 10 Nov exactly as one outlet reported, while a new Announcement No. 58 of 2026 (adopted 9 Nov) immediately re-suspended the same measures through 10 Jan 2027 -- both prior reports were correct about different instruments. (3) Anthropic's IPO order book is REPORTED several times oversubscribed with underwriters weighing pricing above the filed $70-78/share range toward ~$1.5T. (4) A newly-surfaced ISW-CDOT assessment (6 Nov) describes a 100+ vessel PLA/CCG concentration near Taiwan simulating isolation operations, exceeding Justice Mission 2025's scale. Four new forecasts added: Anthropic above-range pricing, a Taiwan named-exercise test, an Iran no-major-strike test, and a Black Sea NATO-attribution corroboration test.
